items.source_en:
Greetings, Citizen of the Empire!

Welcome to Coruscant's Imperial Center, the heart of the Galactic Empire, and the shining jewel of the galaxy. You now stand in the most powerful and advanced city the galaxy has ever known, where the might of the Empire is on full display.

Coruscant has been the center of galactic civilization for millennia, serving as the seat of power for the Moff Council. Whether you are a loyal resident of this illustrious city or a visitor from one of the many systems under Imperial control, you are in the very center of the galaxy's governance, culture, and military strength.

As you navigate Coruscant, know that you are under the vigilant protection of the Imperial Security Bureau and the Stormtrooper Corps, ensuring that your experience in this great city is safe and orderly. The Empire's reach is far, but its heart beats strongest here on Coruscant.

Glory to the Empire, and may your time on Coruscant serve as a reminder of the peace and order that it has has brought to the galaxy.
items.legacy_ko:
제국 시민 여러분, 안녕하십니까!

은하 제국의 심장이자 은하계의 빛나는 보석, 코러산트의 제국 센터에 오신 것을 환영합니다. 여러분은 지금 제국의 위용이 가감 없이 드러나는, 은하계 역사상 가장 강력하고 진보된 도시에 서 계십니다.

코러산트는 수천 년 동안 은하 문명의 중심지였으며, 모프 의회의 권력 소재지 역할을 해왔습니다. 이 찬란한 도시의 충성스러운 거주자이든, 제국 통치하의 여러 행성계에서 온 방문객이든, 여러분은 지금 은하계의 통치, 문화, 군사력의 정점에 계신 것입니다.

코러산트를 다니실 때는 제국 보안국과 스톰트루퍼 군단의 철저한 보호를 받고 있음을 기억하십시오. 이 위대한 도시에서의 경험이 안전하고 질서 있게 유지되도록 보장합니다. 제국의 손길은 멀리 뻗어 있지만, 그 심장은 바로 이곳 코러산트에서 가장 힘차게 고동칩니다.

제국에 영광을. 코러산트에서의 시간이 제국이 은하계에 가져온 평화와 질서를 다시금 상기하는 계기가 되길 바랍니다.

locations.vanilla_source_en:
Hello!

Welcome to the city of New Atlantis, capital of the United Colonies, and for many, the Settled Systems as a whole. You stand now in the most technologically advanced city the human race has ever conceived and constructed. 

New Atlantis was founded in the year 2160, a mere four years after we first arrived in the Alpha Centauri star system. If you're a resident, then you're already familiar with your fantastic home! And if you're a visitor, you are an honored guest of the United Colonies, and will be treated as such. 

Our courteous and professional Security personnel can be found all over the city, and it's their job to ensure your time in New Atlantis is joyful, lawful, and productive.

So as you stroll the streets, or take the NAT train to the city's different districts, know that you are in the embrace of the United Colonies, and couldn't be in better hands.
